note: Curated sample of NASA DONKI FLR (Solar Flare), SEP (Solar Energetic Particle), CME (Coronal Mass Ejection), and GST (Geomagnetic Storm) alerts for offline-first Deep Space operation.

flr_events.note: Impulsive M4.8 solar flare from active region AR3894; moderate HF/X-band radio scintillation risk.
Geoeffective/Mars-corridor X1.9 flare associated with fast halo CME and elevated proton flux.

sep_events.note: Solar Energetic Particle enhancement detected along interplanetary corridor; EVA suspended, ALARA shelter active.

cme_events.note: Fast halo CME (1340 km/s) directed along Earth-Mars transit corridor; shock arrival window +34h.

gst_events.note: G3 geomagnetic storm (Kp=7) increasing high-inclination LEO orbital radiation flux.
